The rock breaker's recipes need glowstone dust as the spark — and the spark used to get eaten, with a circuit-6 toll on top. GTSR rewrites the rule: glowstone dust in rock breaker recipes is never consumed — the circuit-6 toll still applies, but one glowstone dust now lasts forever.

Bulk stone processing turns into a free lunch: the stone keeps rolling out, and not a single reagent is charged.

§8§oFree reagents, endless rocks.§r
